title: Ordering Lunch at the Sunny Café · 新情境写作
instructions: 独立写6—8句、至少40词。再按真实反馈订正；不要照抄源文。同一提示再次使用属于订正或巩固，不冒充未见任务。
prompt:
Write a short message about a meal for you and a friend. Use like, want, can, cannot, and but. Example: I like rice, but my friend does not like rice.
Write 6–8 complete sentences and at least 40 words. Use your own new details. Do not copy the source text.
